primary_sources.title: Self-hosted runners reference
primary_sources.observed_rule: GitHub routes a self-hosted job only to an online and idle runner matching the job's runs-on labels and groups; if none exists the job remains queued; an assigned runner that does not pick up within 60 seconds causes requeue; jobs queued more than 24 hours fail.

primary_sources.title: Using self-hosted runners in a workflow
primary_sources.observed_rule: Label requirements are conjunctive: a runner must match all labels specified by runs-on.

primary_sources.title: Monitoring and troubleshooting self-hosted runners
primary_sources.observed_rule: Runner status distinguishes Idle, Active and Offline; Offline can mean the host is down, runner application is not running, or it cannot communicate with GitHub.
